title.en: The Egyptian Book of the Dead

note.en: E. A. Wallis Budge's translation, from the Papyrus of Ani
note.zh: 巴奇英译本，据阿尼纸草

review.en: Not one book but a body of some two hundred spells, written on papyrus rolls and placed in tombs from the New Kingdom on, to guide the dead through the underworld. Each roll was a selection, often illustrated, as in the Papyrus of Ani. The weighing of the heart against the feather of Maat is its best-known scene. Of great historical worth, uneven as literature.
review.zh: 它不是一本书，而是约两百条咒文的汇集，自新王国时期起写在纸草卷上放入墓中，引导死者穿越冥界。每一卷都是一种选编，常配有插图，阿尼纸草即是一例。最著名的场景，是把死者的心与玛阿特的羽毛放在天平上称量。历史价值极高，作为文学则参差不齐。
